outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured micrographs (photoactivation time-lapse images), not a plot of quantified data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B shows line/scatter plots of normalized fluorescence intensity over time (with fitted diffusion model curves) for each construct, including insets of averaged early time-point responses shown as time-series curves with error bars. Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement, and the main curves already display the raw individual intensity measurements as scatter points.
